newsitem.title: USA: Reno names acting assistant for civil rights.
newsitem.headline: Reno names acting assistant for civil rights.

text.p: Attorney General Janet Reno said Friday Isabelle Katz Pinzler would become the acting Assistant Attorney General for Civil Rights until President Clinton appoints a new candidate to replace Deval Patrick.
Reno announced Patrick's decision to resign and return to private life last November, but a Justice Department spokesman said the search for a new assistant attorney general was "still underway."

Patrick's successor must be confirmed by the Senate, but Pinzler, who has served as a deputy assistant attorney general in the civil rights division since 1994, is not subject to Senate confirmation as an interim replacement.
Pinzler, a national expert on women's rights law, directed the Women's Rights Project of the American Civil Liberties Union, founded by Supreme Court Justice Ruth Bader Ginsburg.
